name: product-feed-converter
description: Turn one product sheet into the import files online stores and shopping ads expect. From a single list of products and variants — SKU, title, description, prices, brand, category, images, stock, barcodes and colour/size options — write a Shopify-style product import CSV, a WooCommerce-style product import CSV and a shopping-ads product feed in RSS/XML. It also reads those store exports back in, so you can move a catalogue from one format to another. Before exporting, it checks every row against each format's required fields and lists what to fix. Runs locally; no store login or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把一张商品表变成网店和购物广告需要的导入文件。从一份商品和规格清单（货号、标题、描述、价格、品牌、分类、图片、库存、条码、颜色尺码）生成 Shopify 式商品导入 CSV、WooCommerce 式商品导入 CSV，以及购物广告用的 RSS/XML 商品 feed。也能读回这些店铺导出的文件，方便在格式之间搬迁商品。导出前按每种格式的必填要求逐行检查，列出需要修改的地方。在本地运行，不用登录店铺，无需 API 密钥。
